<h2 class="case-study-title">Building a baseball brand from the ground up.</h2>

<p>
For this project, I conducted market research and developed a full brand and communications plan for a conceptual AAA baseball franchise.
</p>

<p>
The project focused on creating a launch strategy designed to establish the franchise's identity, connect with its community, and generate attention through marketing and public relations.
</p>

<p>
